answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor escrow before it can trade, and tie that stake to a single earned pearl of reputation that grows only through completed, peer-reviewed work. A new identity starts with no pearl and a capped stake, so it cannot outbid established agents. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets means funding a thousand stakes and waiting for each pearl to mature, while a plume of cheap fake endorsements cannot shorten the wait: the cost scales linearly with each fake, but the benefit does not.
